# API & Interface Design Quality Checklist: Community Detection Framework

**Purpose**: Validate that public API contracts, trait hierarchies, builder patterns, configuration structs, and error types are complete, consistent, and unambiguous
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Core Trait Contracts

- [x] CHK001 Is the `GraphView` trait contract fully specified: associated types, method signatures, complexity guarantees (O(1) neighbor iteration), and panic behavior? [Completeness, contracts/core-traits.md]
- [x] CHK002 Is the `CommunityDetector` trait contract specified with its core method signatures, input/output types, and error handling contract? [Completeness, Gap, contracts/core-traits.md]
- [x] CHK003 Is the `MultilayerView` sealed marker trait (FR-035) specified with its purpose, the sealed pattern mechanism, and forward-compatibility guarantees? [Clarity, FR-035]
- [x] CHK004 Are the trait bounds and supertrait relationships between `GraphView`, `CommunityDetector`, and `MultilayerView` specified unambiguously? [Clarity, Gap]
- [x] CHK005 Is the `AlgorithmConfig` trait (FR-028) specified with its common fields (convergence_threshold, ConvergenceMode) and the contract for algorithm-specific extensions? [Completeness, FR-028]

## Error Types & Validation

- [x] CHK030 Are the domain error types (GraphError, AlgorithmError, PartitionError) specified with their variants and the conditions triggering each? [Completeness, Gap]

- [x] CHK032 Is the negative weight validation requirement (FR-032) specified with the error type returned and the opt-out mechanism contract? [Clarity, FR-032]
- [x] CHK033 Is the zero-panic requirement (Constitution Principle IV) reflected in the API contracts: are all fallible paths returning `Result` rather than panicking? [Consistency, Gap]

## CLI & TUI Interface Contracts

- [x] CHK038 Are the CLI commands specified with their argument contracts: run, compare, batch, convert, metrics, generate, validate? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK039 Is the CLI output format requirement specified: which formats (JSON, CSV, GML) are supported for which commands? [Completeness, Gap] — Satisfied: spec.md FR-042 CLI Output Formats per Command table maps all 7 commands to supported formats with default + content descriptions.
- [x] CHK040 Is the batch configuration format (TOML) specified with its schema and supported parameters? [Clarity, Gap] — Satisfied: spec.md FR-042b defines TOML schema with `[[input]]` array-of-tables, `algorithms`, `parameters` sweep section, `output_dir`, and example snippet.
- [x] CHK041 Is the TUI interface contract specified: event log panel, statistics panel, graph layout, and pedagogical explanation rendering? [Completeness, Gap] — Satisfied: spec.md TUI Interface Contract section defines panel layout (60/40 split + bottom overlay), event log scrollable list, statistics panel fields, Fruchterman-Reingold graph layout, and pedagogical overlay rendering.
- [x] CHK042 Is the pedagogical explanation template requirement specified: static template structure, interpolation points, and content guidelines? [Clarity, Gap] — Satisfied: spec.md Pedagogical Template Structure defines template format, interpolation variables table, content guidelines (2 sentences, WHAT + WHY), and example templates per phase type.
